newsitem.title: USA: Brazil files for $750 million in notes - U.S. SEC.
newsitem.headline: Brazil files for $750 million in notes - U.S. SEC.

text.p: The Federative Republic of Brazil said Friday it filed a registration with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for up to $750 million in notes.
The offering will be made through J.P. Morgan & Co and SBC Warburg, the filing said.
The proceeds from the sale of the notes, after payment of expenses relating to the offering, will be used to refinance internal debt of the government, the filing said.
The notes will be issued in fully registered form only, without coupons, the filing said.
Brazil is the fifth largest country in the world and occupies nearly half the land area of South America.
